articles.title: MSCI Keeps Strategy — For Now — But Handcuffs Bitcoin Buying
articles.mainIdea: MSCI Keeps Strategy — For Now — But Handcuffs Bitcoin Buying
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: MSCI Keeps Strategy — For Now — But Handcuffs Bitcoin Buying. MSCI adopted a new rule governing Strategy and other digital asset treasury firms that will keep their index weightings from growing as they issue more shares to buy bitcoin. MSTR stock jumped in after-hours action following the announcement, though the bitcoin price edged up only slightly, reversing part of the day's loss. While news headlines indicated a positive outcome for Strategy, MSCI signaled that exclusion of Strategy and similar firms is still firmly on the table. Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, MSCI, MSTR, STRC, STRD, STRF, STRK.
